$comment: Crop embeddings (Phase 5): SigLIP 2 base, patch 16, 224 px. The image tower embeds crops, the text tower embeds search text into the same 768-dim space. Components are candidate models; the worker refuses to run without a human approval for each SHA-256. The pipeline's SHA-256 (this file) is the model identity the backend registers and stores with every embedding.
